name: Landhaus Stigger
beschreibung: The Landhaus Stigger is located in the Tiroler Alpen and is surrounded by mountain landscape. The surroundings are ideal for hiking and skiing. The amenities include a traditional restaurant and comfortable rooms. The atmosphere is cozy and alpine. The inn is aimed at holidaymakers seeking relaxation and nature. The regional cuisine with Tiroler Spezialitäten rounds off the offering.
